messages:
sam: quick question — need to pull a single audit event (event_id=0xA12F) to confirm which user triggered a config change for a customer incident. Is this something I can grab from the analytics psql view or do I need to kick off an export/approval? :mag:
maria: you can try the read-only view `audit_events_view` in analytics. note that after 90 days we pseudonymize PII. whats the event date?
alex: if its past 90d we only keep pseudonymized ids and event_hash. full identity needs SEC-LOG-07 flow + signed export job. looping in @security and @sre-oncall.
security-eng-bot: heads up — per policy SEC-LOG-07, identity reconstitution for events >90d requires (1) manager + security approval, (2) SRE-run export with signed job token. template: https://redwood.internal/policies/sec-log-07 :page_with_curl:
sre-oncall: @sam paste the event_id and a short justification. well check whether the raw partition is still in coldstore; if yes we can snapshot a scoped export once approvals exist. we need expiry on the export and S3 temp bucket tagging.
sam: event_id=0xA12F, customer=acme-corp, incident=https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4321. happened ~120 days ago; need user email to confirm account owner.
maria: 120d is >90d so likely pseudonymized. run this quick lookup first to see what data the view returns:
```
SELECT event_ts, event_type, user_id_pseudo, payload_present
FROM audit_events_view
WHERE event_id = '\\xA12F';
```
if user_id_pseudo is non-null we can at least get the pseudonym; if null the raw payload was dropped.
jonah: ops note — if raw partition exists we still need the approvals channel entry (manager + security), short justification, and an expiry TTL for the exported snapshot. avoid including customer PII in the approval message.
sam: filing SEC-LOG-07 request now with my manager + security tag. will post approval screenshot here when done. thanks — cc @maria for standby. :pray:
maria: happy to run the coldstore check after you have approvals so we dont waste cycles.
sam: approved by manager and security (attaching approval token in secure request). filing export job with SRE now. will redact the export S3 link and TTL here once snapshot completes.
sre-oncall: started export job; ETA ~18m. token used: JOB-TKN-... (sensitive) — storing in vault. export scoped to event_id=0xA12F only, expires in 24h.
security-eng-bot: reminder — log this activity in the audit approvals ledger and attach the approval IDs. mark the export as ephemeral and delete after TTL. :lock:
